line_span_analysis.coordinate_semantics: Strict 1-based indexing. Replace/delete require 1 <= start <= end <= n_lines. Insert requires end == start - 1 and 1 <= start <= n_lines + 1.
line_span_analysis.upstream_filtering: SemanticEditIntent.__post_init__ already filters start_line < 1 before host binding. CandidateLineSpanError is caused downstream by coordinates exceeding repository file length or empty file EOF insertions.

Conversational prose following closing fence ('I hope this helps!').

Multiple JSON objects or root JSON array.
